written.headline: Palantir signs $300 million deal with Poland for military AI
written.summary: Palantir Technologies secured a five-year, approximately $300 million agreement with Poland to provide an AI-powered system for military decision-making. The software, called Saturn, will aggregate data from sources such as drones, satellites, and radar to assist commanders.
